item.title: Cornyn Suggests Possible Delay in Blanche Nomination Vote
item.description: A key Senate committee vote on Todd Blanche's nomination for attorney general could be delayed as Republican senators seek more information.

item.title: Haley Stevens Criticizes Abdul El-Sayed as a 'Celebrity Candidate'
